basic_details.application_mode: Offline (application form addressed to The Director, SI-MET)
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the selection process.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 18.11.2026 before 5 pm (last date to receive application)

application_fee.details: The fee can be paid through the SB collect link on the website (www.simet.in), or by challan form downloaded from the website and paid at any branch of SBI. The application form has a row for the fee remitted details, with the date of remittance and the amount.

age_limit.age_details: Up to 50 years; up to 59 years for retired hands
age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for candidates is up to 50 years. For retired hands, the limit is up to 59 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for calculating age, and the age limit is the same for both posts.

qualification.education_qualification: MSc Nursing (Assistant Professor also needs 3 years teaching experience)
qualification.details: The documents list also asks every applicant for copies of the BSc Nursing and MSc Nursing degree certificates and a valid KNMC Registration. The application form asks for the MSc Nursing speciality and the Kerala Nursing Council Registration number with its validity date. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.33,320/- (Assistant Professor) and Rs. 32,450/- (Lecturer), consolidated per month

how_to_apply: Applications are made offline on the form for the post. The notice includes separate forms for Assistant Professor and Lecturer, both quoting Notification No. B/333(2)/2026/SI-MET.
Download the application form for your post from the website www.simet.in.
Pay the application fee through SB collect on the website, or by challan at any SBI branch.
Fill in the form: photo, permanent and contact addresses with district and PIN code, telephone, email ID, age and date of birth, gender, and caste and community (General/SC/ST/OBC).

Enter the academic details for BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing, MSc Nursing and any additional qualification, with the MSc Nursing speciality and the Kerala Nursing Council Registration number and validity.

Fill in the experience tables for experience after BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing and after MSc Nursing, the institutions where you have taught since MSc Nursing, and whether you are presently working.
Sign the declaration and attach the documents listed below.
Address the application to The Director, SI-MET Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O Thiruvananthapuram 695035, so that it is received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date will be rejected. The application form asks for the experience in years, months and days, separated into clinical and teaching (GNM, B.Sc Nursing/PBBSc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing and any other). For more details, contact 0471-2302400 or 9446028080, or visit www.simet.in. The office email on the letterhead is [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The State Institute of Medical Education and Technology (SI-MET) is an institution under the Government of Kerala, described on its letterhead as a Government of Kerala Undertaking. Its Chairperson is the Minister for Health, Government of Kerala, its Vice Chairman is the Secretary, Health & Family Welfare, and its Director is Dr. Asha S Kumar. The office is at TC 94/2750, Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala State – 695035, and these posts are in SI-MET Nursing College Tanur, Malappuram District.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification announces 9 vacant faculty positions in SI-MET Nursing College Tanur. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The documents list also asks every applicant for copies of the BSc Nursing and MSc Nursing degree certificates and a valid KNMC Registration. The application form asks for the MSc Nursing speciality and the Kerala Nursing Council Registration number with its validity date. Candidates should check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility.

rows.experience: Total 3 years teaching experience after MSc Nursing in a collegiate program
The notice does not mention an experience requirement for this post

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for candidates is up to 50 years. For retired hands, the limit is up to 59 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for calculating age, and the age limit is the same for both posts.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The asterisk on both amounts is explained in the notice as "likely to be enhanced". The pay is consolidated, and the notice does not mention any allowances. Nature of appointment: contract basis for one year, renewable based on satisfactory performance. Appointments made to the vacant posts under this notification are non-transferable to other colleges of SI-MET. Candidates residing in Malappuram, Kozhikode and Palakkad districts will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee can be paid through the SB collect link on the website ( www.simet.in ), or by challan form downloaded from the website and paid at any branch of SBI. The application form has a row for the fee remitted details, with the date of remittance and the amount.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made offline on the form for the post. The notice includes separate forms for Assistant Professor and Lecturer, both quoting Notification No. B/333(2)/2026/SI-MET. Download the application form for your post from the website www.simet.in . Pay the application fee through SB collect on the website, or by challan at any SBI branch. Fill in the form: photo, permanent and contact addresses with district and PIN code, telephone, email ID, age and date of birth, gender, and caste and community (General/SC/ST/OBC). Enter the academic details for BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing, MSc Nursing and any additional qualification, with the MSc Nursing speciality and the Kerala Nursing Council Registration number and validity. Fill in the experience tables for experience after BSc Nursing/Post Basic BSc Nursing and after MSc Nursing, the institutions where you have taught since MSc Nursing, and whether you are presently working. Sign the declaration and attach the documents listed below. Address the application to The Director, SI-MET Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O Thiruvananthapuram 695035, so that it is received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form downloaded from www.simet.in Detailed biodata Proof of age Copy of BSc Nursing and MSc Nursing degree certificates Mark lists Experience certificates Valid KNMC Registration Caste/Community certificate and non-creamy layer certificate (for those eligible for communal reservation)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date will be rejected. The application form asks for the experience in years, months and days, separated into clinical and teaching (GNM, B.Sc Nursing/PBBSc Nursing, M.Sc Nursing and any other). For more details, contact 0471-2302400 or 9446028080, or visit www.simet.in . The office email on the letterhead is [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies at SI-MET Nursing College Tanur: 2 for Assistant Professor and 7 for Lecturer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SI-MET Assistant Professor and Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm. Applications received after the last date will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the SI-MET Lecturer and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need MSc Nursing. Assistant Professor also needs a total of 3 years teaching experience after MSc Nursing in a collegiate program.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is up to 50 years. For retired hands, it is up to 59 years.

faq.question: Q5. Can retired employees apply for the SI-MET faculty posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice allows retired hands to apply up to the age of 59 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of an SI-MET Assistant Professor and Lecturer?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.33,320 per month for Assistant Professor and Rs.32,450 per month for Lecturer. The notice says both amounts are likely to be enhanced.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 250 for General candidates and Rs 100 for SC/ST candidates. It is paid through SB collect on www.simet.in or by challan at any SBI branch.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.simet.in, fill it in, attach the documents and address it to The Director, SI-MET Pattoor, Vanchiyoor P.O Thiruvananthapuram 695035 so that it is received by 18 November 2026 before 5 pm.

faq.question: Q9. Is the SI-MET Nursing College Tanur job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on a contract basis for one year, renewable based on satisfactory performance, and it is non-transferable to other colleges of SI-MET.

faq.question: Q10. Which candidates get preference in SI-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates residing in Malappuram, Kozhikode and Palakkad districts will be given preference.
